description: This file contains PHP classes that implement the compilation logic for the Smarty template engine's {capture} tag, including start and end capture block handling.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Capture
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling Smarty {capture} tag start blocks, handling attribute parsing and generating PHP code to initiate output buffering.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_CaptureClose
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling {/capture} closing tags, managing output buffer closing logic and associated cache handling.

methods.name: compileSpecialVariable
methods.description: Compiles code for the special Smarty variable {$smarty.capture.xxx}, retrieving the buffer content from the capture extension.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the start of a {capture} block, generating PHP code to open output buffering and store capture parameters.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the {/capture} end tag, generating PHP code to close the output buffer and manage cache state.
